title: 2 Things You Didn't Know About the Bugatti Chiron
description:
The Bugatti Chiron has one thousand four hundred seventy-nine horsepower. It cost two point four million euros before options. And almost everything people repeat about it is the boring part. Today we are going to show you two things about the Chiron that most people have never heard, and the second one changes how you see the whole car. Here is a hint. The first secret is hidden in a key. Not the key that starts the car, a second one. The second secret is about heat. This engine throws away more energy as heat than it ever sends to the wheels. And the way Bugatti solved that problem is one of the wildest pieces of engineering ever put in a road car.

Every figure in this video comes from a published source, listed below.
